name: CI: Block committed build artifacts
description: GitHub Actions workflow that calls rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows ci-build-artifact-gate.yml. Fails the PR if build outputs (assets/build/ by default) are committed. Stable (merged into release/v1.0.0).

inputs.description: Tag or ref of rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows to call.
Path prefix(es) whose contents must not be committed in a PR. Multiple paths can be newline-separated; for the scaffold default we use a single path.
